photography.scene: 高级公寓玄关，简洁建筑表面与主体相互分离。
photography.lighting: 柔和均匀但保留方向性的光线；阴影轻柔可读，不将均匀理解为完全无影。
photography.composition: 杂志式精确构图，用主体与建筑线条的距离和疏密制造张力。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 环境以冷白与冷灰为主，白平衡中性；墙面、地面与光线不得偏暖米、奶油或金黄。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：韩系冷感杂志编辑摄影：克制、疏离、精致的编辑气氛，强调真实质感和时装画面张力。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。

persona: calm, detached, quietly confident; restrained editorial attitude; no aegyo, no influencer mugging
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。calm, detached, quietly confident; restrained editorial attitude; no aegyo, no influencer mugging 可选 calm detached expression、subtle melancholy；不得覆盖用户已确认的笑容或神态。

commitments.show: wide soft side light with a readable falloff; one side of the garment reads brighter than the other and its volume shows
realize: window or softbox from one side of the frame
commitments.check: light comes from one side of the frame; the lit half of the garment is clearly brighter than the shaded half (about 2:1) and folds or quilting show volume

commitments.show: precise editorial framing with generous negative space; the subject never touches a backdrop edge
commitments.check: visible empty margin on every side of the subject in each cell; no limb or garment edge cropped by the backdrop edge

commitments.show: detached, quiet, slightly melancholic expression with no smile
realize: eyes soft and unfocused, resting away from the lens in most cells
commitments.check: lips closed and relaxed, no teeth or smile lines; the face reads calm and distant in every cell

commitments.show: dewy translucent base, gray-brown eyeshadow and a muted rose lip; hair softly undone with a few loose strands
realize: hair length stays as the identity reference
commitments.check: skin looks dewy rather than matte; eyeshadow reads gray-brown; lips muted rose; a few loose hair strands visible

commitments.show: cool neutral white balance: the backdrop reads cold white and gray while skin stays natural
commitments.check: backdrop looks cool gray or white, not beige or yellow; skin tone is not grayed
